name: manaca-instruct
output_budget_source: Campaign max_tokens=null bounded by native 4096 context; differs from 384 model-card example and 768 serving example.
runtime_differences: BF16 matches official Transformers benchmark; serving uses vLLM rather than Transformers.
vLLM top_k=-1 means disabled, equivalent to llama.cpp top_k=0 in published preset.
Official multi-turn Alpaca extension is used; authors note model was trained single-turn.
BOS is added only if required to match official tok(montar_prompt) token IDs.
Unsupported system/tool roles are rejected instead of silently dropped by upstream template.
